links.outcome: Multimodal LLM accuracy versus expert consensus on retrospective single-institution longitudinal cases
links.effect: High-risk sensitivity 78.8% (95% CI 67.2-87.5), specificity 99.6%; trajectory accuracy 94.7%; 3-level risk accuracy 76.3%. Authors note prospective external validation remains necessary.
links.quote: These findings suggest that multimodal LLMs may support trajectory-based assessment through integration of longitudinal clinical information, although prospective external validation remains necessary.

screen.reason: Retrospective diagnostic accuracy study evaluating a multimodal LLM (ChatGPT) against expert panel consensus for longitudinal trajectory classification and risk stratification of oral lichen planus.
